articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single unified model, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates marked improvements on doctoral-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, raising the bar for frontier model capabilities.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which topped SWE-Bench Verified and internal agentic workflow evaluations, demonstrating an ability to autonomously resolve complex GitHub issues across large codebases. The model integrates tightly with Google Cloud's Vertex AI platform, signaling an aggressive push into enterprise AI agent deployment.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Facility
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots have entered full commercial deployment at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina plant, performing parts inspection, bin picking, and inter-station material transport. The deployment marks one of the first scaled commercial uses of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrated Performing Unsupervised Warehouse Tasks
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot operating autonomously in a warehouse environment, navigating dynamic obstacles, sorting packages, and recovering gracefully from manipulation failures. Elon Musk stated that limited external sales could begin in late 2026, though robotics analysts caution that reliability in unstructured environments remains a significant hurdle.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new orchestration layer for Claude that allows enterprises to define multi-step tool-use workflows with built-in guardrails, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop approval gates. The framework targets regulated industries like finance and healthcare where autonomous AI agents need verifiable decision trails and constrained action spaces.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm GAA Chips, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production at its Fab 20 facility using its N2 gate-all-around (GAA) transistor process, with Apple and NVIDIA among the first customers. The 2nm node delivers roughly 25% better performance and 30% lower power consumption compared to 3nm, which is expected to substantially improve AI training and inference efficiency in next-generation data center GPUs.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits of High-Risk Systems
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act, targeting high-risk AI deployments in hiring, credit scoring, and law enforcement across member states. Companies found non-compliant face fines up to 7% of global revenue, and early reports suggest many organizations are still scrambling to complete required technical documentation and bias assessments.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Next-Gen Atlas with Dexterous Manipulation for Construction
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, debuted an updated electric Atlas humanoid robot with significantly improved dexterous hands capable of manipulating construction tools, turning valves, and threading bolts. The company announced pilot programs with three major construction firms, positioning the platform as a solution for labor shortages in physically demanding and hazardous job sites.
